app_necessity_policy_note: Prefer the mobile-friendly official website unless the app provides a bounded public function that clearly earns ongoing maintenance and review.
app_store_accessibility_policy_note: Accessibility claims should be visible early enough to matter and should not exceed what the released app version actually supports.
app_store_privacy_policy_note: Store privacy and data-safety disclosures should reflect the real practices of the released version and point to a current official privacy/help destination.
deep_link_policy_note: Any deep links or in-app routing should preserve a visible path back to the current official website/help lane when the app is stale, unsupported, or too narrow for the user’s task.
delivery_role_note: A voter-information app can speed routing into current official content, but the app and app-store listing do not become the rule source by themselves.
listing_identity_policy_note: App name, developer name, iconography, and store contact cues should make the authoritative office and jurisdiction recognizable before download.
mobile_app_surface_label: Example State official voter-information mobile-app surface
store_metadata_policy_note: Store descriptions, screenshots, scope statements, and version metadata should not overclaim current election coverage or imply a broader jurisdiction than the shipped app actually serves.
version_recovery_policy_note: Deprecated or unsupported listings should provide visible website or successor-app recovery rather than silently remaining operative as if current.
